entities.name: ClpX ATPase
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt B1HVE5 from Lysinibacillus sphaericus; length 423 aa and 100% identity.
ATP-dependent specificity component of the Clp protease; recognizes substrates and can act as an ATP-dependent chaperone without ClpP.
Forms a hexameric AAA+ ring and associates with ClpP protease rings.
Contains an N-terminal ClpX zinc-binding domain, residues 12–47, with Cys-rich C4 motif.
Contains a central AAA+ ATPase region with Walker A P-loop motif around residues 109–116, Walker B-compatible hydrophobic/acidic region, and conserved pore/ATPase architecture.
Predicted molecular weight 46.6 kDa, acidic pI 4.72, and no transmembrane segment indicated by the sequence analysis.
C-terminal region is consistent with ClpX substrate-processing and oligomerization functions; terminal residues 404–423 are annotated as disordered in the exact reference.

entities.name: ClpP protease
observations: Proteolytic partner of ClpX in the ATP-dependent ClpXP protease complex; ClpX supplies substrate recognition and ATP-driven unfolding/translocation while ClpP performs proteolysis.

entities.name: ClpXP proteostasis
observations: ATP-dependent protein quality-control system involved in selective degradation, protein remodeling, and ATP-dependent folding/chaperone activity; curated annotations include ATP binding, ATP hydrolysis, chaperone activity, and cell division association.
